verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs that connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep documents and mail in sync. That is a first-party API claim, but nothing shows a documented public API reference or specific endpoints for listing mail items or downloading scans. Missing for 10: published public API documentation, endpoints for listing mail items, scan/PDF download endpoints, authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration of developer ingestion.
